description: Check whether a region is symmetric left to right (or front to back), and when it is not, point out **which parts** are not. Use it to grade student builds: the score is the share of symmetric cells, not a gut feeling. How it works: testforblocks only compares by translation, never mirrored, so a mirrored copy is made first with the mirror option of structure save / load and then compared with the original. Warning: this **temporarily writes** to the scratch area: its contents are always backed up first and restored right after the comparison; if the backup fails, it stops without touching the world. scratch must not overlap the analyzed region, or the mirrored copy overwrites the original build. The region is limited by the structure command (64x384x64).

cellsPerAxis.description: Subdivision when the whole region is not symmetric: n parts per axis, n^3 cells, one command per cell

from.description: One corner of the analyzed region

mode.description: absolute = world coordinates; relative = ~ relative to the command source; local = ^ relative to its facing

mirror.description: Mirror axis: x checks left-right symmetry, z checks front-back symmetry, xz requires both

scratch.description: Minimum corner of the scratch area; it is overwritten and then restored, and must not overlap the analyzed region
